environment.hardware_memory_reason: not measured by portable runner; see handoff host preflight

freeze.observation_status: Created before any fixed-fixture candidate runs; no model outputs inspected.

acceptance: All three registered implementations run with unchanged fixture runner and only candidate ID changed
Each learned implementation completes at least one real forward pass and every fixture has an ok or explicit abstain record, with zero error records
Raw outputs and normalized outputs are distinct, linked by hashes and complete for every fixture
Fixtures, protocol, contract, source, model revisions and environment are recorded
A second run under comparable conditions reproduces normalized decisions and native numerical outputs (absolute tolerance 1e-6); latency is descriptive, not an acceptance score
Negative and boundary tests cover invalid inputs, unsupported cases, threshold, non-finite scores, missing artifacts, input limits and no overwrite
protocol.claim_scope: Executable interchangeability smoke test underlying H4; no capability superiority, learned-specialization or MASI system claim.
protocol.dataset_status: Author-created synthetic engineering fixtures; visible to implementers; not held out, not a benchmark, no training or tuning.
failure_conditions: Silent input truncation or label leakage into inference
Failure to preserve native distinctions or to reproduce within tolerance
known_confounds: Tiny synthetic fixtures are visible and not representative
Different pretraining, model sizes, tokenizers and task-specific formatting
Native scores are not calibrated or comparable across candidates
Shared numeric cutoff does not establish comparable operating points
Sequential CPU latency and process lifetime RSS do not measure isolated hardware efficiency
Fixture reference labels are author judgments, not independently reviewed or observed real-world outcomes
protocol.mapping: Learned score >0.5 supported; <0.5 not_supported; exactly 0.5 abstain. not_supported does not imply contradiction. Rule: stripped casefold equality supported, otherwise abstain; no numeric score.
metrics: correct count with all fixtures as denominator (abstain/error not correct)
process lifetime peak RSS with platform units converted to bytes
protocol.omitted_controls: F1/L1/L2/M1 composed-system and training controls are omitted because WP1 does not compare architectures or specialization; no outcomes, router, composition or training is implemented.
protocol.publication: Original synthetic fixtures and code under repository Apache-2.0; exact external model/tokenizer licenses reviewed before integration; weights and downloaded upstream code excluded from Git. No restricted external service is invoked.
protocol.question: Can unchanged calling code invoke a deterministic baseline and two heterogeneous local implementations on identical bounded premise/claim inputs while preserving native output, normalized output, failures and resource provenance?

resource_limits.execution: One candidate per process, sequential runs; no model installation beyond the three pinned model/tokenizer artifacts.

protocol.stop_boundary: WP0/WP1 only; independent audit before WP2/E001 preparation or training. Issues #1/#2 remain broader than this narrow freeze.

resources.rss_scope: process lifetime high-water RSS including imports, load and inference
